name: Nacimiento (Spain)
description: Divided diagonally from the upper fly, yellow above and red below, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Nacimiento (an olive tree on mountains on yellow above waves, beneath a marquess's crown).
history: Nacimiento received permission from the Junta de Andalucía on 26 June 2009 to use officially the arms and flag in use; the flag is rectangular of 3:2 divided into two equal halves by a diagonal from the lower hoist to the upper fly, yellow above and red below.

features.role: Nacimiento arms — olive tree on mountains above waves
